## Proposed workstreams

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `pnpm install` succeeds with the target lockfile
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm release:check` passes
- [ ] Runtime e2e passes when runtime contracts changed
- [ ] README and `docs/plans/dsh-<version>-adaptation.md` updated
- [ ] No unrelated refactors

## Out of scope

- New product features
- Unrelated dependency upgrades
- Auto-merge to `main`
